subject: Evaluation clearance, acceptance checkpoints, and go-live gating for Pioneer Health pilot
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@pioneerhealth.com>, pilot-team@pioneerhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + acceptance checkpoints for Pioneer pilot (proposed)

Hi Sara / Pilot team,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the clarity on the clinical review window. Per our conversation I attached a short Mutual Action Plan that ties the evaluation activities to clear pass/fail criteria and a proposed final cutover (go-live) gating checklist. High level:

- Week 0 (May 10): baseline dataset ingest & smoke tests
- Week 1–2: functional acceptance (7 sample sessions, precision/recall spot checks)
- Week 3: load/latency verification under expected clinic schedules
- Exit gate: all critical regressions <= 2% vs baseline and no P0 errors in 72h

Asks from your side for this schedule to stick: 1) confirmation of which clinician panel will approve model outputs (name + availability), and 2) an internal contact for SOC/compliance sign-off we can parallelize.

Attached: 20270502-PIE-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), draft acceptance tests (pilot-acceptance-test-plan.md).

If the plan looks good we can lock the evaluation start on May 10 and I’ll schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: 20270502-PIE-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot-acceptance-test-plan.md (markdown)

From: Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: pilot-team@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance checkpoints for Pioneer pilot (proposed)

Hi Logan — thanks for sending this over. A couple quick clarifying questions before I confirm resources: 

1) For the "precision/recall spot checks" — can you call out the exact test vectors you'll use? Our clinical reviewers will need a reproducible set to validate.
2) The 72h P0 window: if a P0 surfaces in week 2, is rollback automatic or a manual exec decision?

We can provide the clinician panel (Dr. N. Patel and Dr. S. Ruiz) — they are available May 12–14 to review outputs. For compliance, it’s me but I’ll loop in our security lead after you share the SOC evidence links.

Also we prefer the cutoff for acceptance to be a "no more than 1% critical deviation" for diagnostic labels — can Redwood tighten the criteria or propose mitigation steps if exceeded?

Sara
Pilot Program Manager, Pioneer Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@pioneerhealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance checkpoints for Pioneer pilot (proposed)

Sara — great questions, thanks. Quick responses and a small adjustment to the MAP to reflect Pioneer’s tighter threshold: 

1) Test vectors: we will run the official pilot test suite (attached) which includes 150 labeled cases across the three target conditions + 30 edge-case examples. I'll paste the canonical test vector list into the Drive doc (link below) so your clinicians can inspect inputs/labels.

2) P0 process: our standard policy is to pause traffic and execute the rollback if the P0 is confirmed and impacts correctness. For non-blocking anomalies we follow an emergency patch cadence (2–4hr hotfix window). We can make rollback automatic for the pilot if that gives you comfort — we’ll flag that in the SOW.

3) Acceptance threshold: we can adopt Pioneer’s "<=1% critical deviation" requirement as the primary exit gate. If the deviation is between 1–2% we trigger a mitigation window (7 calendar days) where Redwood will run counterfactuals, apply calibration, and re-run the evaluation. Anything >2% is a fail and prompts rollback.

Next steps:
- Logan: confirm kickoff May 10 in Calendly (I booked a tentative 60m).
- Sara: share Dr. Patel & Dr. Ruiz calendar slots (May 12–14) and security lead contact.
- Sean: I’m going to loop you for the SOW language and the automatic rollback option.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/pilot/DEAL-8231/MAP (test vectors and updated MAP)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: pilot-acceptance-test-plan.md (updated with vector list)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connelly <sara.connelly@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance checkpoints for Pioneer pilot (proposed)

Perfect — appreciate the prompt feedback and the acceptance target. Confirmations here: 

- Kickoff locked: May 10, 2027 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).
- Clinician review: Dr. N. Patel & Dr. S. Ruiz confirmed for May 13, 2027 9:30–11:00 AM PT.
- Security contact: sara.connelly@pioneerhealth.com (you said you will loop in the security lead; please reply-all when available).

I’ve attached the SOW draft with the automatic-rollback clause and the Acceptance Test Plan we’ll use as the canonical living artifact. Quick summary of final exit gates we’ll put in the SOW: 
1) Functional pass: all critical workflow tests pass (7/7) with no new P0s during the verification window.
2) Quality pass: critical deviation <= 1% across the canonical test vectors.
3) Performance pass: mean tail latency < 250ms at 95th pct under expected clinic load.
4) Security/compliance: SOC 2 deliverables uploaded and acknowledged by Pioneer security lead.

If all four gates are green after the final verification window (72h monitoring), Redwood will switch traffic to production routing and sign the pilot completion certificate. If any gate fails we either enter the mitigation window (as described) or rollback depending on severity.

Next concrete items for me: finalize SOW and push DocuSign by EOD May 5.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: sow-draft-Pioneer-2027-05-04.pdf, pilot-acceptance-test-plan.md
